quest.grove_01.name: Through the Green Gate
quest.grove_01.desc: Beyond the second Gate the air is thick with light. The Grove remembers how to grow. Light the Sky Gate of the Whispering Grove (defeat the Lava Colossus) and step through it at the Quai des Huit (/quai).
quest.grove_02.name: Mossy Footing
quest.grove_03.name: First Grove Harvest
quest.grove_04.name: Breathe the Spores
quest.grove_04.desc: Harvest grown crops in the Grove until you earn the Respiration affinity (40 harvests): the spore haze no longer touches you.
quest.grove_05.name: Planting the Roots
quest.grove_06.name: Heartwood
quest.grove_06.desc: Break 64 mangrove logs, the living wood of the Grove.
quest.grove_07.name: Tame the Green
quest.grove_08.name: Let It Grow
quest.grove_08.desc: Keep harvesting in the Grove until you earn the Growth affinity (200 harvests): bone meal grows a crop one more stage, anywhere.
quest.grove_09.name: Wake the Mycelial Queen
quest.grove_09.desc: Defeat the Mycelial Queen, Guardian of the Grove.
quest.heights_01.name: Through the Frozen Gate
quest.heights_01.desc: Beyond the third Gate nothing moves unless you make it. The Heights keep time in their ice. Light the Sky Gate of the Frozen Heights (defeat the Mycelial Queen) and step through it at the Quai des Huit (/quai).
quest.heights_02.name: Cutting Ice
quest.heights_03.name: Blue Cut
quest.heights_04.name: Warmth
quest.heights_04.desc: Cut ice in the Heights until you earn the Warmth affinity (40 blocks): the cold no longer bites you.
quest.heights_05.name: Crystal Spires
quest.heights_05.desc: Break 8 amethyst clusters, the crystals of the Heights.
quest.heights_06.name: Cold Storage
quest.heights_07.name: Stray Hunt
quest.heights_08.name: Stasis
quest.heights_08.desc: Keep cutting ice in the Heights until you earn the Stasis affinity (200 blocks): sneak in the air to slow your fall, anywhere in the Heights.
quest.heights_09.name: Wake the Boreal Watcher
quest.heights_09.desc: Defeat the Boreal Watcher, Guardian of the Heights.
quest.marsh_01.name: Through the Brown Gate
quest.marsh_01.desc: The fifth Gate smells of wet earth and old meals. Nothing here is ever really gone. Light the Sky Gate of the Putrid Marshes (defeat the Mycelial Queen) and step through it at the Quai des Huit (/quai).
quest.marsh_02.name: Muddy Roots
quest.marsh_02.desc: Break 32 muddy mangrove roots, where Rot Resin oozes.
quest.marsh_03.name: Feed the Vat
quest.marsh_03.desc: Right-click a Rot Vat with expired items (rotten flesh, spider eyes, bones...) to salvage them.
quest.marsh_04.name: Filtered Air
quest.marsh_04.desc: Salvage until you earn the Filtered affinity (40 points): the miasma no longer weakens you.
quest.marsh_05.name: Slime Heaps
quest.marsh_05.desc: Break 16 slime blocks from the Landfill and the Weeping Mangrove.
quest.marsh_06.name: Reclaimer
quest.marsh_06.desc: Keep salvaging until you earn the Reclaimer affinity (200 points): a Vat needs fewer items for each Rot Resin roll.
quest.marsh_07.name: Digest the Digester
quest.marsh_07.desc: Defeat the Mire Abomination, Guardian of the Marshes.
quest.citadel_01.name: Through the Golden Gate
quest.citadel_01.desc: Beyond the fourth Gate the hours do not agree with each other. The Citadel counts them all. Light the Sky Gate of the Citadel of Golden Sands (defeat the Mycelial Queen) and step through it at the Quai des Huit (/quai).
quest.citadel_02.name: Dunes of the Citadel
quest.citadel_03.name: Time Surges
quest.citadel_03.desc: Be in the Citadel when the Time Tide surges: you move faster, and Chrono Modules run fast.
quest.citadel_04.name: Time Stalls
quest.citadel_04.desc: Be in the Citadel when the Time Tide stalls: you move slower, and Chrono Modules bank the lost cycles.
quest.citadel_05.name: Gold of the Sands
quest.citadel_05.desc: Collect 16 gold ingots to forge the Chrono Module and the Sandglass.
quest.citadel_06.name: Turn the Sandglass
quest.citadel_06.desc: Collect a Sandglass from the Forge (/forge).
quest.citadel_07.name: A Module That Remembers
quest.citadel_07.desc: Collect a Chrono Module from the Forge (/forge).
quest.citadel_08.name: Wake the Temporal Pharaoh
quest.citadel_08.desc: Defeat the Temporal Pharaoh, Guardian of the Citadel.
